chapters.title: Chapter 1999: Primordial Flames!
paragraphs: Max sensed bloodline combustion from several directions.

Muffled groans echoed through the isolated spaces. A wave of unstable primordial force shook the chamber. Someone’s aura spiked violently before being suppressed by the training facility. Another person’s bloodline power surged so fiercely that the surrounding runes had to descend like chains to stabilize it.
The chamber was helping them awaken their abilities.
It was also preventing them from being destroyed by those abilities.
Max’s eyes remained closed.
He did not envy them.

His awakening was slower because his Tier 4 Primordial Bloodline was at the highest level. If a lower bloodline was like a sealed treasure chest, then his was more like an ancient world locked behind layers of cosmic law.
Forcing it open was not simple. The chamber had to pressure his body again and again, deepen the bloodline combustion again and again, and awaken the hidden ability from the very root of his blood.
On the fifth day, the change finally came.
The golden mist around Max suddenly stopped moving.
The primordial source energy that had been pouring into him like a violent tide became silent for one breath. Then, all of it rushed toward the space between his brows.
Max’s body trembled.
A sharp pain pierced his forehead.
It felt as if something ancient inside his skull was being carved open by fire and law.
His blood boiled.
His soul shook.
His Tier 4 Primordial Bloodline erupted completely.

Golden runes spread across his body, then gathered toward his forehead. The veins at his temples glowed. His eyes turned bright gold for a moment, and the air around him burned with a heat that did not resemble ordinary flame.
Then a vertical line appeared between his brows.
At first, it looked like a thin golden mark.
Then the mark split open.
A third eye opened between Max’s brows.
The moment that middle eye appeared, the entire isolated space became still.

It was not like a normal eye. Its iris was pure gold, but inside the gold were countless tiny primordial symbols rotating in circular layers. At the very center of the eye burned a small flame, calm and sacred, as if it had existed since the earliest dawn of creation.
Max took a slow breath.
He immediately understood something.
This eye was not merely a symbol of awakening.
It was the key.
Only through this middle eye could he activate the true bloodline ability of the Primordial Bloodline. The ability was not like his Black Dragon transformation, which surged through his entire body.
It was not like the Heavenly Luminance Divine Bloodline, which released light through his bloodline source. The Primordial Bloodline ability required this eye to open, observe, command, and ignite.
A name appeared naturally in his mind.
Primordial Flames.
The moment the name surfaced, the small flame within the middle eye expanded.
Golden fire appeared in front of Max.
At first, it was only a tiny wisp.
But the instant it appeared, the entire training space trembled.

The flame did not burn like normal fire. It did not rage wildly like the Devouring Flames. It did not consume with hunger like the black flames of his Black Dragon Chaotic Bloodline. It was quiet, pure, and terrifyingly ancient. Wherever it floated, the surrounding laws seemed to become clearer, as though the flame was not destroying reality, but returning it to a more original state.
Max stared at it with deep eyes.
His black flames and the Primordial Flames were complete opposites.

The black flames from his Black Dragon Chaotic Bloodline were violent, chaotic, devouring, and destructive. They burned with the nature of collapse. They swallowed energy, corroded defenses, consumed vitality, and turned whatever they touched into fuel. They were the fire of a terrifying dragon born from chaos, a flame that existed to tear apart and devour.
The Primordial Flames were different.
They were not gentle, but they were pure.

They carried the aura of origin, refinement, and ancient creation. Instead of simply burning things away, they seemed capable of refining laws, purifying corrupted energy, strengthening bloodline power, and burning through impurities hidden inside a target’s foundation.
If the black flames represented destruction through devouring, then the Primordial Flames represented destruction through returning everything to its original truth.
One flame swallowed.
The other flame refined.
One was dark chaos.
The other was golden origin.
Max slowly raised his hand.
The Primordial Flame drifted above his palm.
The moment it touched his skin, his Tier 4 Primordial Bloodline pulsed again, and the middle eye between his brows glowed brighter.
Max felt his connection to the laws deepen. The surrounding primordial energy bent toward him, and even the hidden fragments of ancient law within the training chamber seemed to respond to the flame.
’So this is the ability of the highest-level Primordial Bloodline,’ Max thought.
He understood why it had taken five days.
The others had awakened their own abilities faster, but none of their bloodline reactions had reached this level. His Tier 4 Primordial Bloodline had not given him an ordinary ability.
It had awakened Primordial Flames, a power that seemed to stand at the very core of what the Primordial Race represented.
Power close to origin.
Power close to law.
Power close to the beginning of everything.
The bloodline combustion inside him slowly settled.

Golden fire still moved through his veins, but it no longer felt like a threat. It had become part of him. His body had endured the forced awakening, and his Unholy Trinity Body had accepted the new power without rejecting the others.
The Primordial Flames now existed alongside his black flames, Divine King Punishment, Emotion Severing Path, Dimensional Keeper Legacy, and all his other powers.
Max closed the middle eye between his brows.
The golden flame vanished.
The training space grew quiet again.
But Max knew that the change was permanent.
From now on, whenever that middle eye opened, he would be able to activate the bloodline ability of his Tier 4 Primordial Bloodline.
Primordial Flames.
A flame born from origin.
A flame completely opposite to the devouring black fire of his Black Dragon Chaotic Bloodline.

chapters.title: Chapter 2000: Mysterious Chaos Tree!
paragraphs: Max could already think of many ways to use the Primordial Flames in battle.

The moment he awakened the ability, possibilities began forming in his mind one after another. He could condense the Primordial Flames into blades, wrap them around his fists, fuse them into his sword strikes, release them as a domain, or combine them with his other laws to create even more terrifying attacks.
Since he had already spent so much time controlling the black flames from his Black Dragon Chaotic Bloodline, his understanding of flame manipulation was far beyond ordinary cultivators.

The black flames were violent and difficult to control, yet Max had learned to shape them with precision, restraint, and explosive force. Because of that experience, he felt that controlling the Primordial Flames would be much easier once he became familiar with their nature.
The Primordial Flames were different from the black flames, but fire was still fire.
The black flames devoured.
The Primordial Flames refined.

One burned with chaotic hunger, while the other burned with ancient purity. If Max could use both properly, then his control over fire would no longer be limited to simple destruction. He could devour with one flame and purify with the other.

He could destroy external defenses with black flames, then burn through hidden impurities, curses, or bloodline corruption with Primordial Flames. Against enemies like devils, that difference might become extremely important.
"I still have one day before the meeting with the devils begins," Max muttered as he opened his eyes. "I should use this time properly."
With that thought, he stood up and left the training chamber.

When he arrived outside, he saw that the others had already left as well. The platforms that had held the ten geniuses were now empty, and the golden spheres above them had dimmed. Faint traces of unstable bloodline aura still lingered in the air, showing how violent their forced awakenings had been.

Max could sense that several of the others had succeeded in awakening their Primordial Bloodline abilities, but their foundations were not completely stable yet. The Level Ten Order had saved time, but it had also left behind strain that would take effort to repair.
Max did not think too much about it.
Everyone had their own path.
He followed the route Sarvion had shown them earlier and soon returned to the room assigned to him within the Primordial Ancestral Domain.

The room was simple, but it carried a quiet dignity. Dark-gold walls surrounded the chamber, soft primordial light flowed through thin lines in the floor, and a faint isolation formation covered the entire space. It was not luxurious, but it was secure, which was all Max needed.
After entering the room, Max closed the door and activated the formation.
Then he directly entered the Dimension of Time.
The world around him changed.
The quiet room vanished, replaced by the vast space inside his own special dimension. Time flowed differently here, and the moment Max entered, he felt the familiar silence wrap around him.

This place had helped him train, comprehend, refine, and prepare for battles many times before. Now that he had finally stepped into the Law Manifestation Realm, many things inside him had changed, and he needed to check them properly.
He had not gotten the chance to do so earlier.

When he broke through to the Law Manifestation Realm inside the inheritance chamber of the Voidwalker Clan, the commotion had shaken the entire Five Sacred Clan domain. Not long after that, he was summoned to the Primordial Race because of the devil crisis.
There had been no peaceful moment for him to sit down and examine the changes in his foundation.
Now, he finally had time.
The first thing Max checked was the Chaos Tree.
The moment he focused on it, his eyes narrowed.
The Chaos Tree had changed far more than he expected.
Compared to how it had been during the Law Refinement Realm, it had grown to an astonishing size. Previously, it had looked like a young tree, mysterious and powerful, but still limited in scale.

Now, it was enormous. Its trunk was thick and ancient, its bark was covered in dark chaotic patterns, and countless branches stretched outward like the veins of a growing world. Different elemental branches extended in different directions, each carrying its own aura, color, and law resonance. Some branches burned with flame.

Some flickered with lightning. Some were wrapped in wind. Some carried the weight of earth. Some shimmered with water, light, darkness, space, and other powers that had taken root inside Max’s foundation.
Standing before it, Max almost felt like an ant.
The difference was too great.
"The size of the Chaos Tree increased far too much after I entered the Law Manifestation Realm," Max muttered as he looked up at the towering tree. "But what is its real benefit?"
He already understood part of the Chaos Tree’s function.

It could grow elemental branches based on the powers he possessed. From those branches, it could produce Chaos Fruits. Those fruits could then be used to grant him Divine Abilities, or they could be given to others to form Divine Bodies.

Over the past few weeks after the tournament ended, Max had plucked many Chaos Fruits from the various elemental branches and handed them to Isabella and the others. Those fruits would be distributed to capable members with good potential within his Crown force.
That alone was already valuable.
A force that could produce people with Divine Bodies would eventually become terrifying.
However, Max did not believe that was the true limit of the Chaos Tree.
It had been born from his Unholy Trinity Body.
Something born from that kind of body should not have such a simple purpose.

"The Chaos Tree is born from my Unholy Trinity Body," Max muttered while his gaze moved across its vast branches. "But unlike the Unholy Trinity Body, which allows me to contain all kinds of powers within my body, I still do not know the real purpose of the Chaos Tree."

sentences.text: Max could already think of many ways to use the Primordial Flames in battle.
The moment he awakened the ability, possibilities began forming in his mind one after another.

He could condense the Primordial Flames into blades, wrap them around his fists, fuse them into his sword strikes, release them as a domain, or combine them with his other laws to create even more terrifying attacks.
Since he had already spent so much time controlling the black flames from his Black Dragon Chaotic Bloodline, his understanding of flame manipulation was far beyond ordinary cultivators.
The black flames were violent and difficult to control, yet Max had learned to shape them with precision, restraint, and explosive force.
Because of that experience, he felt that controlling the Primordial Flames would be much easier once he became familiar with their nature.
The Primordial Flames were different from the black flames, but fire was still fire.
The black flames devoured.
The Primordial Flames refined.
One burned with chaotic hunger, while the other burned with ancient purity.
If Max could use both properly, then his control over fire would no longer be limited to simple destruction.
He could devour with one flame and purify with the other.
He could destroy external defenses with black flames, then burn through hidden impurities, curses, or bloodline corruption with Primordial Flames.
Against enemies like devils, that difference might become extremely important.
"I still have one day before the meeting with the devils begins," Max muttered as he opened his eyes.
"I should use this time properly."
With that thought, he stood up and left the training chamber.
When he arrived outside, he saw that the others had already left as well.
The platforms that had held the ten geniuses were now empty, and the golden spheres above them had dimmed.
Faint traces of unstable bloodline aura still lingered in the air, showing how violent their forced awakenings had been.
Max could sense that several of the others had succeeded in awakening their Primordial Bloodline abilities, but their foundations were not completely stable yet.
The Level Ten Order had saved time, but it had also left behind strain that would take effort to repair.
Max did not think too much about it.
Everyone had their own path.
He followed the route Sarvion had shown them earlier and soon returned to the room assigned to him within the Primordial Ancestral Domain.
The room was simple, but it carried a quiet dignity.
Dark-gold walls surrounded the chamber, soft primordial light flowed through thin lines in the floor, and a faint isolation formation covered the entire space.
It was not luxurious, but it was secure, which was all Max needed.
After entering the room, Max closed the door and activated the formation.
Then he directly entered the Dimension of Time.
The world around him changed.
The quiet room vanished, replaced by the vast space inside his own special dimension.
Time flowed differently here, and the moment Max entered, he felt the familiar silence wrap around him.
This place had helped him train, comprehend, refine, and prepare for battles many times before.
Now that he had finally stepped into the Law Manifestation Realm, many things inside him had changed, and he needed to check them properly.
He had not gotten the chance to do so earlier.
When he broke through to the Law Manifestation Realm inside the inheritance chamber of the Voidwalker Clan, the commotion had shaken the entire Five Sacred Clan domain.
Not long after that, he was summoned to the Primordial Race because of the devil crisis.
There had been no peaceful moment for him to sit down and examine the changes in his foundation.
Now, he finally had time.
The first thing Max checked was the Chaos Tree.
The moment he focused on it, his eyes narrowed.
The Chaos Tree had changed far more than he expected.
Compared to how it had been during the Law Refinement Realm, it had grown to an astonishing size.
Previously, it had looked like a young tree, mysterious and powerful, but still limited in scale.
Now, it was enormous.
Its trunk was thick and ancient, its bark was covered in dark chaotic patterns, and countless branches stretched outward like the veins of a growing world.
Different elemental branches extended in different directions, each carrying its own aura, color, and law resonance.
Some branches burned with flame.
Some flickered with lightning.
Some were wrapped in wind.
Some carried the weight of earth.
Some shimmered with water, light, darkness, space, and other powers that had taken root inside Max’s foundation.
Standing before it, Max almost felt like an ant.
The difference was too great.
"The size of the Chaos Tree increased far too much after I entered the Law Manifestation Realm," Max muttered as he looked up at the towering tree.
"But what is its real benefit?"
He already understood part of the Chaos Tree’s function.
It could grow elemental branches based on the powers he possessed.
From those branches, it could produce Chaos Fruits.
Those fruits could then be used to grant him Divine Abilities, or they could be given to others to form Divine Bodies.
Over the past few weeks after the tournament ended, Max had plucked many Chaos Fruits from the various elemental branches and handed them to Isabella and the others.
Those fruits would be distributed to capable members with good potential within his Crown force.
That alone was already valuable.
A force that could produce people with Divine Bodies would eventually become terrifying.
However, Max did not believe that was the true limit of the Chaos Tree.
It had been born from his Unholy Trinity Body.
Something born from that kind of body should not have such a simple purpose.
"The Chaos Tree is born from my Unholy Trinity Body," Max muttered while his gaze moved across its vast branches.
"But unlike the Unholy Trinity Body, which allows me to contain all kinds of powers within my body, I still do not know the real purpose of the Chaos Tree."
